title: Carousel Video Ads for Product Stories | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product photo into an ordered video story: open, reveal, use and finish. Add your headline, price and call to action after download.
h1: Carousel Video Ads That Tell One Product Story
lead: One product shot rarely answers every shopping question, while a full carousel takes several cards to design. Upload one photo and get an ordered story clip for feeds and ads.
benefits_h2: Why sellers choose carousel video templates

benefits.t: One file instead of several cards
benefits.d: The ordered clip plays open, reveal, use and finish in one video, so you get the persuasive flow of a carousel without designing and uploading separate panels.

benefits.t: Every beat answers a shopper question
benefits.d: The first beat earns attention, the next shows the feature, another proves it in use and the last gives the next step. Buyers move through the story instead of scrolling past.
Use 1:1 in feed placements and 9:16 in Reels and Stories, with clips at 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. A longer cut lets each beat breathe when the product needs explanation.
Place headlines, prices, dimensions and calls to action in your editor so every number stays exact. The download carries no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your own ads.

steps_lead: Choose a story style, add your product, generate. No card design and no multi-file upload.

steps.d: Add one clear photo that gives the product a recognizable shape and useful detail.
Choose an open, reveal, use or finish scene, then generate the ordered clip.
Download the video and add your headline, price or call to action in your editor.

faq.q: What is a carousel video ad template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made product story. Add one photo and generate a single clip that moves through a few ordered beats.

faq.q: Do I need to write prompts to use these templates?
faq.a: No. Pick a story style, upload your product photo and generate. Step two can include one short line about the beats if you want.

faq.q: Who are carousel video templates built for?
faq.a: Ecommerce sellers and agencies that need a product story for feeds, listings or paid ads without designing several cards.

faq.q: Is the output one file or a platform carousel post?
faq.a: The template creates one video file. Upload it wherever you publish, then add your text and link in that platform or editor.

faq.q: Can one sequence show several product beats?
faq.a: Yes. Use an opening, a reveal, one useful action and a clear finish so each beat answers one shopper question.
Use 1:1 for a square feed or 9:16 for a vertical placement. Choose the frame that fits where the clip will live.

faq.q: How fast is a carousel video made?
faq.a: A clip is generated in minutes after you start the job, with no card design, shoot day or multi-file upload.

faq.q: What does a carousel video cost?
faq.a: A 15-second sequence costs 60 credits, and the charge is shown before you run it.

faq.q: Can I use the sequence in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your own ads, pages and posts. You remain responsible for claims and offers.

steps.sourceHint: Show the whole backpack and its main compartments.
